verdict.rationale: Pipecat has a hosted Pipecat Cloud service, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question, but the evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Community notes that local inference via ollama or whisper is possible describe a user-side self-hosting workaround, not a product capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
